召す: ぶちのめす fragment (めす), not 召す
下る: くだらん = くだらない 'trivial/worthless', not 下る 'go down'
打ちのめす: written ぶちのめす (variant form of the same verb; fine)
突き合わせる: sentence has 付き合わせ (付き合わせる 'make accompany/involve'), not 突き合わせる
わっ: わっかんない = 分かんない (わからない) with emphatic small っ, not the interjection
放つ: 放っておく = leave alone (放っておく idiom); sense 'set free' closest
直し: 呑み直し = 呑む + 直し (do over again, suffix), not 'correction'
根: 根っから = through and through (adverb/idiom)
彼此: かれこれ here is the adverb 'for around/nearly (several decades)', not 'this and that'
八百屋: おやおや is an interjection 'oh my', not greengrocer
藪: やぶから棒に = 'out of the blue' idiom; not thicket/quack
収まる: 気が収まらない = 'can't be satisfied/calmed down' idiom
取り扱う: inflected 取扱い as 'handle/deal in' (merchant context)
蛸: タコ殴り = being beaten up en masse, not 'octopus'
因み: ちなみに = by the way (set phrase), not 'association'
助太刀: fine as a word; noun/suru sense (helping in a fight)
ぶれる: ぶれいくだんす = ブレイクダンス (breakdance), fragment of a loanword, not ぶれる
勿体: もったいない is a fixed adjective phrase, not standalone 勿体
曲げる: 首曲げ男 is a name/epithet fragment (首曲げ), literal bend sense only loosely applies
